log.text: Collect, grow & show off plants/creatures in your own zoo — inspired by Plant Zoo 2nd Generation
Brief uploaded. R&D: do a deep gameplay review of Plant Zoo 2nd Generation.
Plant Zoo 2 not findable online; use proven loop (restock seeds > grow > $/s > mutations/weather > expand > rebirth), twist: seeds grow into creatures, no stealing

Planet Zoo 2 review done: copy its loop (biome needs->Thriving x1.5, cross-pollination genes, Release to the Wild = rebirth w/ permanent bonus + World Reserve, photo quests, Seeds of Hope market) but cut its friction (grid build, 1-tap fixes) - menus/micromanagement/bugs made Steam Mixed 63%
Sprout Zoo: buy random-rarity seeds, grow 28 plant-creatures, match biomes for Thriving x1.5, earn $/s, Release to the Wild to prestige
Approved spec: name Sprout Zoo, Super Luck pass yes
Audio done: Sounds.luau (50 sounds, 11 real IDs, rest Id=0 + search terms), SoundController + MusicDirector (zone/weather/night crossfade, biome ambience, MusicOn/SFXOn). See notes/audio.md

Full v1 server built (plots, seed restock+luck, offline growth, needs/Thriving, tip jars, weather+mutations, pads/biomes, Release, daily, quests, Hope shop, likes, leaderboard, monetization). Contract in notes/gameplay.md; 3 minor questions.
